intro: The 202M Advance shoe cabinet brings structure to busy lives—offering durable materials with smart design to keep your footwer neatly stored and lasting calm in the everyday rush of home.

features.title: Engineered for lasting durability
features.text: Made with high-grade melamine-faced chipboard (MFC), our design resists life’s wear and tear—giving you peace of mind for years to come.

features.title: A seat that simplifies your day
features.text: We’ve added a seating surface right on top, so putting on or taking off shoes is no longer a balancing act. It’s the little convenience that becomes a daily comfort.

features.title: Smart storage that holds your rhythm
features.text: With room for up to 18 pairs, our internal layout keeps your footwear sorted and accessible—so you're never digging through a pile when you're running late.

features.title: Easy access without extra fuss
features.text: Groove-style handles give you grip without bulk. No protruding knobs or hinges—just smooth, subtle access that keeps the design clean and the function simple.

features.title: Ventilation that keeps things fresh
features.text: We’ve built airflow directly into the back of the cabinet, so odours don’t linger and your shoes stay fresher—especially in closed spaces.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
